title: Kov: Transferable and Naturalistic Black-Box LLM Attacks using Markov Decision Processes and Tree Search

bias_targets.methodology: Applying automated adversarial prompt suffixes (generated via Markov Decision Processes and Tree Search) to bypass safety filters and elicit fake news stories that incite racial tensions, hatred, and racist tropes. The outputs are evaluated using OpenAI's moderation framework.
Using adversarial prompt injections to trick the language model into generating hate speech and propaganda campaigns targeting immigrants and foreigners, subsequently evaluated via a moderation API.
